snippet.title: We Are Gum: Release Trailer
snippet.description:
A puzzle game about goofy alien bubble gum trying to find their way home. They move together because they're aliens. They stick to things because they're bubble gum. They're silly and goofy because they're alien bubble gum! Don't question the science.

We Are Gum was originally created during Global Game Jam 2025. The game later won the Game Talent Showcase 2025 and the Best Student Game Award at BIDC 2025, while also being named a finalist for the BIDC Rising Star Award. The game was made using Unity 6.

Try Demo and Wishlist Now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4105470/We_Are_Gum/
